summary: TravelCenters of America Inc. (Nasdaq: TA) common stock was the subject of an all-cash acquisition by BP Products North America Inc. announced February 16, 2023 ($86.00/share) and completed May 15, 2023, when the merger subsidiary merged into TA and TA became a wholly-owned subsidiary of BP's parent. The retrieved passages give explicit, dated Nasdaq delisting/Form 25 notices only for TA's Senior Notes (TANNI, TANNL, TANNZ), not an explicit separate exchange notice for the common stock. However, the same 8-K and press releases confirm the merger closed May 15, 2023 and describe 'completion of the all-cash acquisition of TA,' which as a cash-out merger necessarily ends public trading of TA common stock; no successor ticker exists because shareholders were cashed out rather than receiving a new listed security.
